department: Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1; fall entry only.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not accepted for Fall 2027 PhD applications.
gre_general.quote: Note that GRE scores are not being accepted as part of our M.S. and Ph.D. applications for Fall 2027.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages fetched.

english_waiver.value: Test waived after at least two years of English-taught study in a country where English is the official language.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL or IELTS exam is required of all international applicants from countries where English is not the official language unless the applicant has studied for at least two years in a country where English is the official language and the language of instruction was English.

supervisor.value: Most students find an advisor during their first semester on a fellowship or TA.
supervisor.quote: Most students do not choose a Ph.D. advisor before applying.

funding.value: Five years of funding for all admitted PhD students in good standing.
funding.quote: We offer five years of funding to all admitted Ph.D. students (contingent upon maintaining good academic standing).

entry_route.value: Applying with only a B.S. is the typical path.
entry_route.quote: Can I apply for a Ph.D. degree even if I will only have a B.S. degree? | Yes. This is the typical application path.

notes: Aerospace Engineering, Robotics and Theoretical and Applied Mechanics are separate MAE PhD fields with the same December 1 deadline; choose one field when applying.
